components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident, compact action for the next step.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button">Invite teammates <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2M10 7a4 4 0 1 0 0 8M19 8v6M22 11h-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--brand, #286b5e); color: #fff; font: 700 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover, #20594e); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b8d70; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Quiet utility action that gains a surface on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Toggle appearance"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.9 13A8.5 8.5 0 0 1 11 3.1 8.5 8.5 0 1 0 20.9 13Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #738077); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-icon-button:hover { border-color: var(--line, #e3e8e1); background: var(--surface-soft, #f7f8f5); color: var(--ink, #202923); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b8d70; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled, high-contrast field for account and invite details.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #46544a; font: 700 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; height: 47px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #dce4dc; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #26322a; font: 400 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #859188; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: #568873; outline: 2px solid #4b8d70; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(53, 121, 87, .12); }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Separates identity and office context from connection and account actions.
components.html: proxispeakThe Commons Team officeConnected
components.css: .ds-navigation { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 0 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e8e1); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #202923); font: 500 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--ink, #202923); font: 800 19px 'Manrope', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.9px; } .ds-mark { width: 25px; height: 25px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--brand, #286b5e); color: #eff6e8; } .ds-mark svg { width: 12px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-office { display: grid; gap: 3px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-office small { color: var(--muted, #738077); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-connection { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #738077); } .ds-connection i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #438765; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67, 135, 101, .13); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-navigation { min-height: 60px; padding: 0 14px; } .ds-office { display: none; } }

components.description: The spatial work surface; zones, range, and avatars carry the meaning.

components.css: .ds-map-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e8e1); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(26, 40, 31, .07), 0 2px 7px rgba(26, 40, 31, .04); } .ds-map-title { min-height: 53px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 18px; color: #3f4b42; font: 700 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-map-title span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #438765; } .ds-map-title small { margin-left: 5px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 1px solid #d4ddd3; color: #97a199; font-size: 9px; } .ds-map { min-height: 180px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; margin: 0 10px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background-color: var(--map-ground, #eef1eb); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(53, 76, 58, .075) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(53, 76, 58, .075) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; } .ds-zone { position: absolute; display: grid; place-items: start; padding: 10px; border: 1px dashed rgba(73, 101, 75, .22); border-radius: 12px; color: #738077; font: 700 8px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-library { inset: 12% auto auto 8%; width: 28%; height: 42%; background: rgba(219, 226, 210, .55); } .ds-studio { inset: 15% 25% auto auto; width: 34%; height: 52%; background: rgba(199, 216, 195, .5); } .ds-range { position: absolute; top: 66%; left: 26%; width: 76px; height: 76px; border: 1px dashed var(--brand, #286b5e); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(183, 219, 109, .14); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-avatar { position: absolute; top: 66%; left: 26%; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brand, #286b5e); color: #fff; font: 700 7px 'Manrope', sans-serif; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

components.name: Presence Row
components.description: A teammate name and explicit state with a reinforcing avatar indicator.
components.css: .ds-person-row { min-height: 62px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 5px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e8e1); color: var(--ink, #202923); font: 400 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-person-avatar { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 2px solid var(--surface, #fff); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--brand, #286b5e); color: #fff; font: 700 9px 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-person-avatar i { position: absolute; right: -2px; bottom: -1px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: #7d9780; } .ds-person-info { display: grid; flex: 1; gap: 4px; } .ds-person-info strong { color: #3f4b42; font-size: 11px; } .ds-person-info small { color: var(--muted, #738077); font-size: 10px; } .ds-person-status { color: var(--muted, #738077); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; }

components.name: Microphone Permission
components.description: Permission status with a direct, clearly named recovery action.
components.html: ♫Microphone access is offAllow access to talk with teammates nearby.
components.css: .ds-mic-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e8e1); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-soft, #f7f8f5); color: var(--ink, #202923); font: 400 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-mic-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--brand-soft, #e9f2ea); color: var(--brand, #286b5e); font-size: 18px; } .ds-mic-copy { display: grid; flex: 1; gap: 3px; } .ds-mic-copy strong { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-mic-copy small { color: var(--muted, #738077); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-mic-action { min-height: 39px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--brand, #286b5e); color: #fff; font: 700 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mic-action:hover { background: var(--brand-hover, #20594e); } .ds-mic-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b8d70; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-mic-banner { gap: 8px; padding: 9px; } .ds-mic-action { min-height: 37px; padding: 0 9px; font-size: 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
ProxiSpeak makes shared presence legible as a place. The floor plan is the primary work surface; the teammate rail and microphone state support it without competing for attention. Pine-green identity, mineral map tones, fine measured linework, signal-lime range marks, and warm voice accents translate distance into a calm, readable interface.

The workspace favors practical density and direct manipulation: teammates can scan the room, search the roster, move around the floor, and reach the microphone control without leaving the map. Sign-in and registration carry the same identity through a dark, illustrative office panel beside a quiet, high-contrast form. The workspace supports both light and dark themes.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained surfaces with precise green, lime, and warm voice-state signals.
Functional controls remain discoverable across pointer, keyboard, and touch layouts.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Green identifies presence and primary action; lime identifies range; terracotta identifies proximity or voice. Do not interchange these meanings.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for display and title roles; keep operational copy and controls in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Few-Lifted-Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Keep the roster and map interior quiet; reserve the clearest elevation for the main map, the active voice dock, and the auth illustration.

dos: Do make the floor map the dominant workspace surface and keep the roster as its supporting rail.
Do use semantic colors consistently: green for identity/presence, lime for range, and terracotta for nearby voice.
Do provide text alongside microphone, connection, and presence indicators.
Do keep forms scrollable and map interactions usable on touch screens.
Do preserve a visible keyboard focus indicator and the reduced-motion treatment.
donts: Don't replace the spatial office with a generic stack of dashboard cards.
Don't suggest the sign-in illustration is live team data; it is labeled as an illustration.
Don't use color alone to describe microphone permission, voice, connection, or account state.
Don't let fixed controls cover the map, roster, or a form action on small screens.
